code_findings.effect: Valid positive finite support is rejected; no incorrect completed ordinary path was observed. This boundary is far outside competition-sized annual factors; source inputs/observations were not read.
code_findings.expected: Constant positive gross support 5e-324 has inverse-cube CE exactly 5e-324 for any valid weights.
code_findings.observed: (.2*5e-324, .3*5e-324, .5*5e-324) rounds to (0,0,0), causing ValueError: portfolio gross factor must be positive before log-sum-exp can stabilize the moment.
code_findings.requested_fix: Use a stable log weighted gross or scaled dot product and add independent subnormal regression; preserve all normative parameters.

design_closure.D1: Eligible-first filtering, maximum-anchored epsilon ties, active/defensive/central/growth priority and final strict hurdle close both concrete ambiguities.
design_closure.D2: Paired median and fold medians; marginal Q10/Q90 differences; fixed adaptive controls [balanced_context, balanced_cost], both required even if context promotion fails; primary and sensitivity separate.
design_closure.L1: Gamma, targets and buffer remain normative; pooled marginal/myopic CE and exchangeability/dependence caveats explicit.
design_closure.L2: Own horizons and intersected horizon/liquidity eligibility A/E=C; B/D=C,B; C=C,B,G explicit.
design_closure.L3: Inclusive risk, p10 growth and indifference screens; all exclusions, denominator, severe loss and reasons required; no guarantee.
design_closure.L4: Own-tolerance suspension rerun AND risk/purchasing-power rescreen at own horizon, failed class referred without reselection/fallback.
design_closure.L5: Fold-exclusion/immutable calibration requirements retained; kernel timing independently tested, calibration implementation outside scope.
design_closure.L6: All sixteen mode/fee cases, direct comparisons and failed trials retained; doubled fee cannot retune primary.
design_closure.L7: Tiny requests execute with exact positive fee and active-state change independent of reporting epsilon; first deployment/year-1 deferred flag separated.
design_closure.L8: Sequential observer matches independent rational CPI, holdings, fees and post-fee/year-end peaks; production adapters remain separate.

exact_fixes: K1: Compute each portfolio log gross without multiplying tiny factors by weights first, e.g. logsumexp(log(weight_i)+log(gross_i)) over positive weights, or an equivalently scaled positive dot product; retain zero-weight handling, positive finite validation and the existing inverse-cube/mixture formula. Add a regression with all factors float.fromhex("0x0.0000000000001p-1022"), weights (.2,.3,.5), expected CE equal to that positive factor. Do not clip, impute or silently redefine supported input bounds. Source fix belongs to chief/separate assigned task.
